svg.title: Butler asks before it acts
svg.desc: A Butler window. You ask Butler to rename the screenshots on your Desktop by date. Butler looks at the Desktop and finds 24 screenshots, then asks for permission: Edit 24 files in 'Desktop'? You press Allow once. Butler renames the files and replies that nothing else was changed.

g.text: Rename the screenshots on my Desktop by date
